lesson.title: Wonder as Navigator
lesson.topic: Exploring how genuine curiosity and wonder can guide personal growth and discovery, leading to a deeper understanding of oneself and the world.
lesson.steelman: How can one's sense of wonder be systematically applied to solve complex problems or navigate challenging life situations?
lesson.example: A scientist whose insatiable curiosity about nature led them to groundbreaking discoveries in quantum physics.

rationale: Encouraging learners to view wonder not just as a passive emotion but an active guiding force.
